sources.traffic_flow: HERE Traffic API v7 /flow (speed, free-flow speed, jam factor, traversability)
sources.incidents: HERE Traffic API v7 /incidents (closures, accidents, construction, flooding reports)
sources.weather: Weatherstack current observations at one point per city

calibration_split.note: Development (October 22 to November 8: 18 days covering every day of the week, with three weekends) fits the hourly CRITIC weights, development maxima and Cheng references; tuning fixes q0, beta and the search time limit; test is held out for the comparison. October 31 to November 2 (Undas: All Saints' and All Souls' Days) is kept in development, so the weights also reflect holiday traffic; no holiday falls in the tuning or test periods.
calibration_split.revised: 2026-10-23: collection extended from 2 to about 4.5 weeks after the timeline changed to 5 weeks; no tuning or test data existed and no weights had been fitted when the periods were revised (the earlier split was development October 22-28, tuning October 29-30, test November 3-7). Same day: Undas (October 31 to November 2) is kept in development instead of being excluded.

sampling.calibration: the first capture of every development hour (up to 432 hours); all 30,511 directed segments are the alternatives in each hour
sampling.tuning: 12 origin-destination pairs on random tuning-period captures
sampling.test: 30 origin-destination pairs on random test-period captures, 5 seeds each
